# statuspage_metrics_provider (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage metrics provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_metrics_provider" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metric_base_uri` (String)
- `type` (String) One of: Pingdom, NewRelic, Datadog, Self, Librato, CalabashCustom.
